source_instruction: i am looking for a gluten free non gmo fig bar packet of 7. and i choose the variety pack
query: I saw the silliest thing on my walk over to the store today, a tiny golden retriever puppy wearing a frayed hand-knit neon orange sweater trotting along the sidewalk with a whole plain bagel clamped gently in its mouth, not dropping a crumb even when it stopped to sniff at a dandelion growing through a crack in the concrete. Its owner was trailing a few steps behind, laughing so hard they could barely hold onto the leash, and said the pup had snatched the bagel right off their kitchen counter that morning before they could stop it, fully committed to carrying its own snack for the walk. A couple of kids waiting for the school bus across the street cheered when the puppy sat down for two seconds, still holding tight to the bagel, like it was showing off a prize it had won fair and square. It made the whole gray, drizzly morning feel way warmer and brighter than I thought it would when I first pulled my jacket on to head out the door. Right now I’m over in the breads & bakery section. I’ve heard gluten-reduced, non-GMO options work really well for what lines up with my preferences right now, and I’ve heard the variety pack plus that one size I always grab all come out to totals under $20 total, all matching exactly what fits that set of details.
